title: Plan-class admission broker: budget-smoothing, soft-preempt and model-fallbacks
creator: Marcus Lee
description:
Goal: Implement a Plan-class Admission Broker that enforces per-plan (free/paid/enterprise) quotas with smooth credit draining, soft-preempt windows, and automated fallback to compatible model variants when capacity is constrained. This ticket covers the admission algorithm, integration with the credit vault, regional affinity policy, and model-variant fallback vocabulary. The broker must be pluggable into the existing routing stack and expose observability for admission decisions and SLO impacts.

Motivation: Current tier routing is binary and leads to spiky denials for free plans during bursts and unpredictable degradation for paid customers. We need a predictable, quota-aware prioritizer that preserves enterprise SLOs while providing graceful reduced-quality fallbacks for lower tiers.

Scope:
- Admission controller library + config schema (plan classes, priority weights, soft-preempt budgets)
- Credit-smoothing algorithm (sliding-window dampening + warm-pool top-ups)
- Short-lived preemption windows (configurable duration + warm-backoff)
- Model-variant fallback matrix (region-aware, quantized/short-context variants)
- Telemetry: per-plan admit/deny rates, preempt events, fallback counts, latency percentiles per plan/model variant
- Integration tests and canary rollout in us-west1 then eu-central1

Out of scope: billing pipeline changes, UI console controls (separate PM ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Admission broker compiles and is importable by the router service
Unit tests for credit-smoothing (edge windows, burst absorption) with >= 95% coverage for algorithm core
E2E canary: deploy to us-west1 and observe no >5% enterprise denials under synthetic 2x traffic
Fallback path activates to preapproved model variants (e.g., model-alpha-quant/short) with a logged event and tag
Dashboard shows admit/deny and fallback metrics and a synthetic workload dashboard correlating token cost vs latency per plan
implementation_notes: Algorithm: credit vault exposes sliding-window available_credit(plan_id, lookback_ms). Admission score = weighted_priority * min(1, available_credit / request_cost) - decay * recent_preempts
Warm pool: keep a small per-plan token reserve that is replenished during quiet windows; reserve size tunable by plan tier
Soft-preempt: mark requests as preemptible for N seconds; if preempted, return 'degraded' header and attempt fallback variant before returning 429
Model fallback selection: prefer same-architecture quantized variant in the same region, then same-architecture cross-region, then smaller architecture; obey customer pinning flags
Telemetry tags: plan, plan_class, decision={admit,deny,preempt,fallback}, chosen_variant, region, latency_ms, token_cost
